source: begin
insert into documents (collection, created_by) values ($1, $2) returning id
select id from documents where id = $1 and deleted_at is null for update
select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('mogging_slug:' || 'documents'::regclass::oid::text || ':' || $1::text))

select 1 as x from document_shared s join documents d on d.id = s.doc_id where d.collection = $1 and d.deleted_at is null and d.id <> $2 and (s.is_head_published or s.is_head_draft) and s.data ->> 'slug' = $3 limit 1

select coalesce(max(version), 0) as max_version, max(version) filter (where is_head_draft) as draft_version, max(version) filter (where is_head_published) as published_version from document_shared where doc_id = $1
update document_shared set is_head_draft = false where doc_id = $1 and is_head_draft
insert into document_shared (doc_id, version, state, data, is_head_draft, created_by) values ($1, $2, 'DRAFT_HUMAN', $3, true, $4)
select id from documents where id = $1 and deleted_at is null for update

select coalesce(max(version), 0) as max_version, max(version) filter (where is_head_draft) as draft_version, max(version) filter (where is_head_published) as published_version from document_localized where doc_id = $1 and locale = $2
update document_localized set is_head_draft = false where doc_id = $1 and locale = $2 and is_head_draft
insert into document_localized (doc_id, locale, version, state, data, source_hashes, is_head_draft, created_by) values ($1, $2, $3, 'DRAFT_HUMAN', $4, $5, true, $6)
select date_trunc('milliseconds', clock_timestamp()) as t
select 1 as x from document_shared where doc_id = $1 limit 1
select version, state, is_head_draft, is_head_published, data from document_shared where doc_id = $1 and is_head_draft
select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('mogging_slug:' || 'documents'::regclass::oid::text || ':' || $1::text))

select 1 as x from document_shared s join documents d on d.id = s.doc_id where d.collection = $1 and d.deleted_at is null and d.id <> $2 and (s.is_head_published or s.is_head_draft) and s.data ->> 'slug' = $3 limit 1
update document_shared set is_head_published = false, unpublished_at = $1::timestamptz, unpublished_by = $2 where doc_id = $3 and is_head_published

update document_shared set state = 'PUBLISHED', is_head_published = true, is_head_draft = false, published_at = $1::timestamptz, published_by = $2, unpublished_at = null, unpublished_by = null where doc_id = $3 and version = $4
select date_trunc('milliseconds', clock_timestamp()) as t
select 1 as x from document_localized where doc_id = $1 and locale = $2 limit 1
select version, state, is_head_draft, is_head_published, data from document_localized where doc_id = $1 and locale = $2 and is_head_draft
update document_localized set is_head_published = false, unpublished_at = $1::timestamptz, unpublished_by = $2 where doc_id = $3 and locale = $4 and is_head_published

update document_localized set state = 'PUBLISHED', is_head_published = true, is_head_draft = false, published_at = $1::timestamptz, published_by = $2, unpublished_at = null, unpublished_by = null where doc_id = $3 and locale = $4 and version = $5
commit
